CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_show_staff_approval_pin(p_show_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(role text, pin_code text, is_active boolean, user_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  select
    p.role,
    p.pin_code,
    p.is_active,
    p.user_id
  from public.show_staff_approval_pins p
  where p.show_id = p_show_id
    and p.user_id = auth.uid()
    and p.is_active = true
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.regenerate_my_show_staff_approval_pin(p_show_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_role text;
  v_pin text;
begin
  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Not signed in';
  end if;

  select ra.role
    into v_role
  from public.role_assignments ra
  where ra.show_id = p_show_id
    and ra.user_id = v_user_id
  order by case ra.role
    when 'super_admin' then 1
    when 'admin' then 2
    when 'reporting_clerk' then 3
    when 'superintendent' then 4
    else 99
  end
  limit 1;

  if v_role is null then
    select 'admin'
      into v_role
    from public.shows s
    where s.id = p_show_id
      and s.owner_user_id = v_user_id
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_role is null then
    raise exception 'You do not have a staff role for this show';
  end if;

  loop
    v_pin := lpad((floor(random() * 1000000))::int::text, 6, '0');

    exit when not exists (
      select 1
      from public.show_staff_approval_pins p
      where p.show_id = p_show_id
        and p.pin_code = v_pin
    );
  end loop;

  insert into public.show_staff_approval_pins (
    show_id,
    user_id,
    role,
    pin_code,
    is_active
  )
  values (
    p_show_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_role,
    v_pin,
    true
  )
  on conflict (show_id, user_id)
  do update set
    role = excluded.role,
    pin_code = excluded.pin_code,
    is_active = true;
end;
$function$
